generation_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a reusable transparent PNG logo for Power!, an open-source powertrain modeling studio with engine, transmission, thermal and electrical physics. Primary request: design one polished, distinctive logo with a compact mechanical rotation / flowing energy symbol beside the exact wordmark "Power!". Style: flat vector-like graphic, strong clean geometry, restrained technical character, readable at small sizes. Composition: one horizontal lockup, ample transparent margin, centered, no presentation board. The symbol should suggest coupled rotation and energy transfer with a subtle P-shaped silhouette; avoid a generic power-button icon. Text (verbatim): "Power!" with a clear exclamation mark, confident contemporary sans-serif. Use a restrained high-contrast treatment suited to a dark desktop studio while remaining visible on a light background. Constraints: genuinely transparent background; no mockup, photo, 3D rendering, gradients, bevels, tagline, extra text, watermark or existing company marks. Deliver the actual logo asset.
refinement_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Edit the provided Power! logo. Preserve the exact symbol geometry, wordmark spelling "Power!", layout, green rotating arrow and genuinely transparent background. Make one targeted palette correction: change every dark navy element, including all lettering and the outer gear and hub, to a solid medium blue #2366C4 so the logo is readable on both white and dark backgrounds. Make the other blue arrow and lightning bolt solid bright cyan-blue #159EEF. Use perfectly flat solid fills throughout, no gradients, textures, shading, glow or bevel. Keep the same sharp edges and composition. No new text or objects.
